blocks.data: label:When the race starts: no gravity, I move myself
label:When the countdown says go: I can drive
label:Start each tick with the normal numbers: road speed, and on rails (no sliding)
label:Off-road slowdown: grass and dirt are slower than road
label:Grip and drift: my tyres stop only some of a slide each tick, and on ice hardly any
label:Steer: turn when I'm rolling, the other way when I reverse
label:Split my speed: forward (the way I point) and sideways (sliding)
label:Boost pads: a boost pad shoots me forward, then the extra speed fades
label:Gas and brakes: gas speeds me up to my top speed, brakes slow me and then reverse, and I coast to a stop
label:Grip: sideways sliding fades by my grip
label:Drive: move, and bounce off barriers (go inside to see how)
label:Drive and bounce off barriers: turn my two speeds into x and y speeds, move, bounce off anything solid
label:When I finish my last lap: stop, and put my name on the results
